comment: What an unattended session may run beyond an assisted one, on top of allowlist.json and allowlist.assisted.json (docs/MODES.md). Only `add` is read: commands, public_reads, broker_commands and graphql_mutations, each a list added to the level before. Nothing here can lift a refusal the broker makes in code (owners, files named on the command line, `pr merge --admin`, api writes). `pr review` is only ever an approval of a pull request renovate[bot] or dependabot[bot] opened, every commit on it the bot's own and signed by GitHub, every required check on its head green and no other failed or still running, with a body; the broker checks that and sends the approval itself. `workflow run` takes no input read from a file. Widening this file is a reviewed change.
